content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Rockford

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate, or equivalent) and completion of required project management education hours. Crucially, no prior work experience is needed—making CAPM ideal for Rockford professionals entering or advancing in project management roles across Advanced Manufacturing, Healthcare, Logistics, and other local industries.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp-style course. Our intensive format compresses the required contact hours into a focused learning experience, delivered entirely online so you can earn certification without disrupting your schedule at employers like Woodward, Mercyhealth, UPS, or other Rockford organizations.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your education, submit your official application to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the submission process to ensure all eligibility documentation is accurate and complete before you proceed to the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Study using Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources and practice materials. Our instructors—active certified practitioners—support your readiness with targeted review sessions and Q&A forums, then you sit for the proctored CAPM exam, which tests your knowledge across project management frameworks and real-world scenarios.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM certification is valid for three years. Maintain your credential by earning professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or professional activities. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to keep your certification current and your skills competitive in Rockford's evolving job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
